name: s1b-a1-release
argv:
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
from looplora.llm import s1b_artifacts as a, s1b_data as d
root=Path('/work/xg24i002/x10041/LoopLora/runs/slot-loop-v1/s1b/a1-8457587')
common=["--mode","release","--manifest",str(root/"manifest.lock.json"),"--branch-record",str(root/"branch.json"),"--read-settings",str(root/"read-settings.json"),"--pilot",str(root/"pilot/pilot.json"),"--smoke",str(root/"smoke/smoke.json"),"--science-commit","258f5f5a24eae684f640a9fd62679bb643470a76"]
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"scripts/prepare_s1b.py",*common,"--out",str(root/"candidate.json")],check=True)
candidate_digest=d.old.file_digest(root/"candidate.json")
assert a.read(root/"candidate.json")["status"]=="pending_reload"
reloads=[]
for arm in ("M1","M4","S1","S4"):
    out=root/"reload"/arm
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","looplora.llm.s1b_run","--mode","reload-check","--manifest",str(root/"manifest.lock.json"),"--release",str(root/"candidate.json"),"--export",str(root/"smoke"/arm/"selected.pt"),"--predictions",str(root/"smoke"/arm/"reload_samples.npz"),"--arm",arm,"--out",str(out)],check=True)
    reloads.extend(["--reload",arm+"="+str(out/"reload.json")])
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"scripts/prepare_s1b.py",*common,*reloads,"--out",str(root/"release.json")],check=True)
assert d.old.file_digest(root/"candidate.json")==candidate_digest
_,release=a.require_release(root/"release.json",root/"manifest.lock.json")
smoke=a.read(root/"smoke/smoke.json")
for arm in release["arms"]:
    assert a.read(root/"reload"/arm/"reload.json")["export_blake2b_128"]==smoke["arms"][arm]["selected_checkpoint_blake2b_128"]
assert release["status"]=="ready" and len(release["config_hashes"])==12 and release["steps"]==18000
assert all(v["walltime_seconds"]<=16*3600 for v in release["arms"].values())
print(json.dumps(dict(stage="S1B-A1",status="ready",reloads=4,configs=12,release_blake2b_128=d.old.file_digest(root/"release.json"))),flush=True)
